topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: When I met my childhood best friend after all these years, I approached with a smile, eager to reconnect. We had spent countless days together, from climbing trees to building makeshift forts in the backyard. But when I mentioned those memories, their eyes showed no spark of recognition. It was as if the years we shared had been erased, like they never existed. Yet, I didn’t let that dampen my spirits. Instead, I took it upon myself to remind them of our adventures, to retell the stories with such vivid detail that it felt like we were back in those moments again. Seeing their face light up, even if just for a second, made me realize the value of keeping those memories alive, not just for them, but for all the shared history that ties us together.
